title: Dia Browser header
description: A floating, fixed pill header in translucent near-white with a hairline. Desktop: a compact centred pill (symbol plus three quiet links that brighten on hover), and a second waitlist pill that fades and grows in at the top right once the hero is scrolled away. Phones: a full-width rounded bar with the wordmark and a thin plus that turns into a cross and opens the links.
notes: fixed and takes no height: the hero runs underneath it
the phone menu is a plain details element: no JavaScript
the top-right pill appears between 380px and 450px of page scroll (CSS scroll timeline); it always shows where scroll timelines are unsupported
